== Summary ==
Slip “•Jabiim: Starship Hangar” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (769, 1543, 1456, 2091)). Version [[Jabiim: Starship Hangar|Jabiim: Starship Hangar (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
